snippet.title: Into the fold - Nala Junction Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now!
A fast-paced boomer shooter set in a strange mountain town. Blast through enemies, explore deadly levels, and fight to survive. Inspired by classic '90s games. The game is set to release in Q4 2025. 
Coming Q4, 2025. Wishlist now!
